description: Change a schedule's NAME / WHAT IT RUNS (a test case or a suite — `testCaseId` or `suiteId`; the schedule switches between Test Case and Suite as the Scheduler form does, keeping the same id) / time / recurrence / end date / timezone / browser / environment / release / sprint, or RE-PIN its agent. Pass `scheduleId` (from schedule_list) and ONLY the fields to change. To re-pin: mode:'local' + `agentId` (from local_agents), or mode:'cloud' + a runner's `cloudRunnerCredentialId` (the `credentialId` from cloud_runners). Requires a live connection.

agentId.description: Local re-pin: an agent credential_id from local_agents.

browser.description: New browser for a WEB test case / suite schedule. For a SCHEDULE on SimplifyQA, 'chrome' (and 'chromium') = Chrome, 'msedge'/'edge' = Edge, 'firefox', 'webkit'/'safari' = Safari — chrome is fine; on Walnut a schedule accepts only chromium/msedge/firefox/webkit. A schedule whose mode is CLOUD is headless too: offer only Chrome Headless / Firefox Headless / Edge Headless there.

cloudRunnerCredentialId.description: Cloud re-pin: a runner's credentialId from cloud_runners.

dayOfMonth.description: Monthly 'ON DAY': 1–30; default = the start's day.

daysOfWeek.description: Weekly: the weekdays to run on (MONDAY … SUNDAY or MON … SUN); default = the start's weekday. Monthly with `occurrence`: the one weekday.

endDate.description: New ISO end date (for recurring schedules).

interval.description: REPEAT EVERY N for hourly / daily / weekly / monthly — N hours / days / weeks / months (e.g. hourly + 2 = every 2 hours). Default 1; giving it alone changes the schedule's current cadence. With 'every_5_minutes' it is the N in 'every N minutes'.

mode.description: Re-pin target: pair with agentId (local) or cloudRunnerCredentialId (cloud).

name.description: Rename the schedule (3–501 characters, unique in the project) — the name the Scheduler shows.

occurrence.description: Monthly 'ON THE': the first / second / third / last weekday of the month — give the weekday in daysOfWeek.

releaseId.description: Release: id, code (RE-44) or exact name; "none" clears it. A suite schedule needs one.

scheduleType.description: New recurrence (same choices as the UI: once, every_5_minutes, hourly, daily, weekly, monthly). Anything but once needs an endDate.

sprintId.description: Sprint: id, code (SP-1) or exact name; it must belong to the release. "none" clears it.

suiteId.description: Make it run THIS suite (id or code, e.g. SU-4) — a test-case schedule becomes a Suite schedule (which needs a release). Not together with testCaseId.

testCaseId.description: Make it run THIS test case (id or code, e.g. TC-35) — a suite schedule becomes a Test Case schedule. Not together with suiteId.
